The line segment $\overline{XY}$ is a diameter of a circle. Given that $X$ and $Y$ have coordinates $(0,-4)$ and $(0,4)$, respectively, what is the equation of the circle?" :question/worked-solution "The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the point $(a,b)$ is

$$
(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2.
$$

Using the distance formula to compute the distance between the points $X(0,-4)$ and $Y(0,4),$ we find that the length of the diameter is

$$
\begin{aligned}XY & =\sqrt{(0-0)^2+((-4)-4)^2} \\  & =\sqrt{(0)^2+(-8)^2} \\  & =\sqrt{0+64} \\  & =\sqrt{64} \\  & =8.\end{aligned}
$$

So the radius of the circle is

$$
r=\frac{XY}{2}=\frac{8}{2}=4.
$$

Since the center of a circle is the midpoint of the diameter, to find the center we use the midpoint formula as follows:

$$
(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2})=(\frac{0+0}{2},\frac{-4+4}{2})=(0,0)
$$

So our circle has radius $r=4$ and center $(a,b)=(0,0),$ and therefore it is represented by the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2 & =r^2 \\ (x-0)^{2}+(y-0)^{2} & =(4)^2 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =16\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["23d9e69b-cf15-53f1-9f50-45549244746a"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "eb21ace1-79e6-5dbe-a280-1c9fd5977a76" :answer/id #uuid "eb21ace1-79e6-5dbe-a280-1c9fd5977a76" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=7" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c8d01676-d1ba-5a15-8d7a-8cd472232df9" :answer/id #uuid "c8d01676-d1ba-5a15-8d7a-8cd472232df9" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=196" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "55708c35-0697-5f17-b709-5ae8338a0b33" :answer/id #uuid "55708c35-0697-5f17-b709-5ae8338a0b33" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(x+7)^{2}+{y}^{2}=49" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "50de2ef5-ddd9-528e-ab8f-241817f3dca1" :answer/id #uuid "50de2ef5-ddd9-528e-ab8f-241817f3dca1" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=49" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4a3f64a6-7826-547e-a7b7-53df738b623f" :answer/id #uuid "4a3f64a6-7826-547e-a7b7-53df738b623f" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(x-7)^{2}+{y}^{2}=49" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4c5dc3cc-6d23-518e-973a-a46e3aea3a49" :answer-field/id #uuid "4c5dc3cc-6d23-518e-973a-a46e3aea3a49" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["eb21ace1-79e6-5dbe-a280-1c9fd5977a76" "c8d01676-d1ba-5a15-8d7a-8cd472232df9" "55708c35-0697-5f17-b709-5ae8338a0b33" "50de2ef5-ddd9-528e-ab8f-241817f3dca1" "4a3f64a6-7826-547e-a7b7-53df738b623f"] :answer-field/correct "50de2ef5-ddd9-528e-ab8f-241817f3dca1" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "60ffb3ff-5c9f-5c7d-98b1-bdc0a2df9a06" :question/id #uuid "60ffb3ff-5c9f-5c7d-98b1-bdc0a2df9a06" :question/problem "![](images/ce/ce6082e3e2563073817e143e8ce91b10c171d0e894d5ed3bea25d925c6fe718f.png)

The line segment $\overline{XY}$ is a diameter of a circle. Given that $X$ and $Y$ have coordinates $(-9,-1)$ and $(3,-1)$, respectively, what is the equation of the circle?" :question/worked-solution "The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the point $(a,b)$ is

$$
(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2.
$$

Using the distance formula to compute the distance between the points $X(-9,-1)$ and $Y(3,-1),$ we find that the length of the diameter is

$$
\begin{aligned}XY & =\sqrt{((-9)-3)^2+((-1)-(-1))^2} \\  & =\sqrt{(-12)^2+(0)^2} \\  & =\sqrt{144+0} \\  & =\sqrt{144} \\  & =12.\end{aligned}
$$

So the radius of the circle is

$$
r=\frac{XY}{2}=\frac{12}{2}=6.
$$

Since the center of a circle is the midpoint of the diameter, to find the center we use the midpoint formula as follows:

$$
(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2})=(\frac{-9+3}{2},\frac{-1+(-1)}{2})=(-3,-1)
$$

So our circle has radius $r=6$ and center $(a,b)=(-3,-1),$ and therefore it is represented by the following equation:
